correctness.rationale: The graph is 14-vertex, 21-edge trivalent Fano incidence with edges p_i–ℓ_j when i−j∈{0,1,3} mod7. The full-vertex reduced Świątkowski weight-three chain basis counts C0=binom(23,3)=1771, C1=14·2·binom(22,2)=6468, C2=binom(14,2)·4·21=7644, C3=binom(14,3)·8=2912. Differential is signed replacement of a half-edge difference by incident edge variables. An independent sparse GF(p) chain generator/eliminator reconstructed matrices at the exact fixed artifact convention, checked d²=0 and computed ranks (1770,4689,2911) mod2 and (1770,4690,2911) mod3, giving Betti (1,9,44,1) and (1,8,43,1). Independently decoded frozen artifacts/d3_kernel.json: 881 nonzero entries ±1 over 2912 ordered basis vectors, and direct integer sum of signed boundaries has ZERO nonzero entries (literal integral cycle), so gcd=1. Since rank(d3 mod3)=2911, rank_Q(d3)≥2911; nonzero integral cycle gives rank_Q≤2911, hence rank_Q=2911 and ker(d3:Z^2912→Z^7644) rank1 saturated and generated by primitive cycle. C4=0, proving H3(B3 H;Z)=Z. No claim for integral H1/H2 or other primes.
